message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a white background and a red vertical stripe along the left edge. At the top, the large green word "TEMPO" is centered. Below it, in smaller black letters, is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Above the main title, smaller black text reads "UANG SEMIR ADIK ZULKIFLI HASAN" and "KRAKATAU STEEL DI UJUNG TANDUK", separated by a thin gray vertical line.

The central image is a large black-and-white silhouette of a bear facing right. The upper half of the bear’s body is composed of vertical black-and-white stripes resembling a barcode. The lower half of the bear, including its legs and underbelly, is solid white, blending into the background.

In the bottom right, large green text reads "SATWA ILEGAL TAMAN SAFARI". Beneath this, smaller black text says: "LEMBAGA KONSERVASI TERBESAR DI INDONESIA INI DIDUGA TERLIBAT DALAM PERDAGANGAN ILEGAL HEWAN DILINDUNGI, MENYERTAKAN KURATOR DAN JARINGAN INTERNASIONAL."

The bottom left contains publication details: "8-14 APRIL 2019", "RP 45.000", and "WWW.TEMPO.CO". A barcode and the number "00007" are also present.
